title: Make macOS Native AOT release trim-safe
description: Replace Avalonia reflection bindings and reflection-based System.Text.Json paths with compiled bindings/source-generated metadata; audit third-party database providers so Native AOT diagnostics can be restored to errors without suppressions. The early-release build is genuinely Native AOT but currently preserves complete metadata for compatibility.
notes:
Build 5 fixes AOT definition and agent-policy persistence and moves the 293 MB dSYM beside the app. The stripped executable is 169.6 MB: roughly 74.9 MB managed code and 74.6 MB constants/type metadata under OptimizationPreference=Speed plus complete reflection metadata. Further reduction requires closing the remaining trim/AOT warnings before complete metadata can be disabled.
Build 14 removes first-party reflection dependencies structurally: compiled Avalonia bindings throughout, source-generated System.Text.Json contracts, an owned static dock-layout DTO, IsAotCompatible on every first-party source project, reflection disabled by default, complete type metadata disabled, and architecture tests banning reflection fallbacks, metadata roots, and AOT suppressions. Full gate and real macOS AOT UI smoke test pass. Remaining NativeAOT diagnostics are confined to third-party assemblies (Oracle and database providers, Dock/DataGrid, Vanara via SMBLibrary, and the vendored optional Exclr8Cef performance path); restoring warnings-as-errors requires replacement, exclusion, or upstream AOT-safe releases rather than first-party metadata preservation.

title: Repair clean release workflow inputs

notes:
The first push also exposed Security Analysis as a clean-run consumer: CodeQL lacked both libghostty-vt.so and generated terminal fonts. Provision the verified linux-x64 native terminal payload before the manual CodeQL build and enforce ordering with an architecture contract test.
Fresh Linux runners exposed a second native gate defect: Zig records SONAME libghostty-vt.so.0, while the staged P/Invoke payload is intentionally named libghostty-vt.so. The disposable ABI probe now gets a major-version runtime alias and rpath without changing the published package surface.
Managed matrix failures exposed three more platform-clean issues: libc close was imported with the wrong case; Windows CRLF checkout invalidated hashed catalogs/patches; terminal tests lacked host native runtimes. Repository text is now LF-stable, the Linux import targets close, and clean Linux/macOS/Windows native runtime artifacts gate and feed managed jobs. Windows uses the official pinned Zig 0.16.0 host archive rather than an ABI-incomplete Linux cross-build.
The local AOT bundle reached provenance validation and correctly exposed that managed-components.json still reviewed first-party project identities at 0.1.0. The next immutable candidate is 0.1.4, so only GhostShell project identities, document name, and SPDX namespace are advanced to 0.1.4; native/third-party versions remain pinned.

title: Fix provider completion steering test timeout under suite load
description: The pre-push full gate intermittently times out GovernedAgentRuntimeTests.Provider_completion_during_changed_notification_uses_the_captured_turn_token after five seconds. The same 812-test suite passed in two preceding full runs and the isolated test passes in 107 ms.

notes: Root cause: the Changed subscriber blocked a thread-pool worker with SpinWait while the provider completion was explicitly scheduled asynchronously. Under full-suite thread-pool load, the continuation could not run before the five-second assertion. The test now uses an inline completion only for this scenario and asserts completion inside the callback without spinning.

title: CEF startup rejects development profile link
description: Launching the macOS development bundle exits during embedded Chromium startup with: Browser profile storage contains an unexpected filesystem link. Diagnose the exact link and preserve fail-closed handling for unsafe profile roots while accepting/removing legitimate CEF artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: The macOS development bundle starts with a legitimate existing CEF profile tree. Unsafe root/ancestor/reparse-point substitution still fails closed. Focused tests and the full repository gate pass.
notes: Root cause had two parts: CEF creates legitimate singleton/version symlinks inside its owned profile tree, and macOS Chromium requests the generic Chromium Safe Storage key even for GhostSHELL's ephemeral contexts. Fixed by deleting child links without following targets while rejecting a linked root, and by enabling Chromium's documented use-mock-keychain switch only when cache/session persistence is disabled. Exact macOS development bundle reached the running GUI; focused Browser tests passed 15/15; ./scripts/check.sh --full passed.
close_reason: Closed
